policy: Posthoc source diagnostic at unchanged original discovery clock. Scene includes catalog T<=18 stars inside stamp plus one-pixel margin, deduplicated at .01pixel, with relative flux fixed from Tmag rather than independent free fluxes; hypotheses all included sources within3pixels of target. Linear TIC proper motions from J2000; no parallax. Out-of-event scene registers common shift; fixed registration for event/leave-one-out fits. Each source fit additionally includes two catalog-scene spatial derivatives as motion nuisances; compare motion-only and source-only fits. Posthoc model sensitivity, not host probabilities.
